description: Oscillator that reads its waveform from a table of random noise, refilled on demand from one of three noise sources

params.text: Refills the wavetable with fresh noise

inputs.text: Shifts the frequency set by the freq knob a volt per octave, the voltage clamped to -4V to 4V
A rising edge refills the wavetable with fresh noise

menu: table size — a slider setting the length of the wavetable, 64 to 1024 samples, which takes effect at the next refill
rand — fills the wavetable with independent random values at the next refill
simplex — fills the wavetable from a smooth simplex noise curve at the next refill
worley — fills the wavetable from a cellular worley noise pattern at the next refill
noise increment — a slider setting how far apart the wavetable's samples are taken in the simplex and worley noise, 0.01 to 0.1, so how jagged the wave is
